name: KuchenHouse
summary:
KüchenHouse Kitchens allows you to enter a 100% interactive shop and see your new kitchen, bathroom or dressing room from the sofa in your home. You decide, on the street, from your Oculus Quest or both at the same time.

You will be able to walk around and interact with the kitchen elements and shop assistants in real time, as if you were physically in their kitchen. You can even talk to customers in your living room or in one of the KüchenHouse shops who are physically in the shop viewing your project.
